scope: Final stable header slabs, typed value/packet metadata, and nested long-name scratch; ordinary release with unchanged dependencies and fat LTO. Only final 706e574 timing samples contribute to summaries; earlier diagnostic trials and 84474cc stage2 samples remain checkout-local and are superseded.

validation.independent_review: Read-only ownership/aliasing review found no concrete safety defects; CPU review identified remaining throughput work.

layout.id_lookup: dense non-owning pointer directory; slot counter/publication and inline token descriptor precede cold metadata

limitations: Requested heap excludes host input, stack, allocator overhead, RSS, and pdfTeX memory.
Slab/page slack increases fixed-workload space; typed pages retain per-class capacity until their last buffer owner disappears.
Large metadata arrays can allocate one block each; small token survivors can pin partially occupied pages.
Public message Vec<Vec<u8>> ownership intentionally retains per-message result allocations.
Native INITEX parameter stack has 60 entries: paired live-packets depths 10/30/50; larger packet diagnostics are allocation-only.
CPU regressions remain in parameters, groups, long arguments, metadata construction, and selected broader cases; allocator correctness/allocation gains do not imply CPU neutrality.
No layout, checkpoints, fonts, output backend, Wasm runtime timing, or universal allocator framework is implemented.

kernels.name: spelling
kernels.adaptation: Definitions unchanged. Bootstrap ifcanspell with let instead of loading plain newif. The preceding aesthetic macro needs an accent and is omitted.

kernels.name: today
kernels.adaptation: Definition unchanged. Define plain's space macro and assign calendar parameters explicitly.

kernels.name: talks
kernels.adaptation: Definition unchanged. Consume expanded sentences in definitions rather than typesetting them.

kernels.name: contentsentry
kernels.adaptation: Retain the complete write payload in a parameterized macro invoked in edef. Stringified line/dotfill names and braces are never executed. Bootstrap pageno with countdef.

kernels.name: maketable
kernels.adaptation: Retain the bracketed-title and paragraph-delimited signature; replace the box/display body with edef of both complete payloads.

broader.validation: Every record compares its expanded definition with independently generated expected tokens; comparison and expected definition construction are timed.
broader.storage: Immutable definitions and token lists are reclaimed after their last semantic owner; bump chunks and value IDs are reused. Interned names remain session-owned.

memory.scope: Full-process CPU/wall medians; allocator requests cover engine construction/execution and exclude the compact host input. Heap peaks are requested bytes, not RSS. pdfTeX memory is not measured by this adapter.

packet_growth_above_oracle_capacity.scope: Allocation-only beyond native INITEX parameter stack capacity 60; both diagnostic engines validate identical complete sources. No pdfTeX or timing claim.
